request_preview: Hi — I am buying on behalf of a customer. I need 2 of SKU-KETTLE-1L (1L Electric Kettle), listed at ₹4,990 each. What can you do on price for 2?

json.message: We can offer you a special price of ₹4,640 per unit for 2 kettles, bringing your total to ₹9,280. If you'd like to add any complementary items like our toaster or blender, I can look into even better bundle pricing for you.
json.rationale: Opened negotiations with an initial 7% discount for a two-unit purchase while preserving headroom below the 15% mandate limit and probing for a potential bundle.
